note: Camping (core/game/game_camp.gd; drawn by ui/play/roadside_art.gd; checked by tools/check_data.gd). The Tent (items.json, `camp: true`; stocked by the hunters' lodge and the caravans, never by the old shops) is used on open ground, from the pack pane's Use button, the Camp key (input.json `world_camp`) or the heir's thing menu: it pitches a camp where the heir stands. Refused in a town or any place's ground (`town_margin` tiles beyond it), indoors, upstairs, in a fight, inside a smoke cloud, while one camp stands, and with no tent. The camp is runtime only (GameSandbox.camp, never saved): it is struck when the heir walks more than `strike_tiles` away or `seconds` of the world clock pass. Resting at the camp (Use beside the fire, or the menu's Rest) heals the heir and the party by `heal_share` of their health and `mp_share` of their mana and lets `rest_years` of a year go by (GameDynasty.pass_time), at most `rests` times for each camp. The camp fire cooks the `cook` recipe (materials from the stores into a meal): it heals the heir by `heal` of their health and lays the blessing `spell` on the next fight (GameCasting's blessing, the same one a temple casts), at most `cooks` times for each camp. A fire keeps creatures off: while the camp stands, a creature within `night_radius` tiles of it at night (`day_radius` by day, 0 for none) starts no fight and none spawns there (the smoke pot's rule, weaker). A fight the heir flees from ends beside the camp when it stands within `escape_range` tiles. Nothing here draws a die of the dynasty's but the years a rest lets go by, and the autopilot never camps.
